front.title: PSI-03: Receipts for Virtual Power Plant Dispatch Records

abstract.t:
This document defines PSI-03, a domain profile of Proof of Stateful Integrity (PSI) for dispatch instructions and metered responses exchanged between a virtual power plant operator and its distributed energy resources. Each record is sealed as a PSI receipt so that later alteration, reordering, or removal is detectable. Only digests are sealed. PSI-03 shows integrity and ordering only; it does not show that a resource performed as instructed, that metering is accurate, or that any market rule was met.
Earlier revisions carried this title over an abstract describing practitioner identity bonds. This revision makes the body match the title.
